skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
The outfit this Operator wears most often.
While not as practical as a uniform, it's what they find most comfortable.

skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
An outfit that has been improved after the Operator's Promotion.
Custom-made to suit each Operator's experiences and needs, these outfits are designed to provide them maximum flexibility on any battlefield. Furthermore, this is all done without compromising the comfort that they've come to expect.

skins.name: The Chainsaw Nurse
skins.content: Storyboard Breaker Serialized Comic [Beyond Redemption] Final Character Art/The Chainsaw Nurse. Outfit of the nurse from the Hospital of Horror in the story. Her gigantic chainsaw and conspicuous sutures are proof enough that she, the first masterpiece, lives on to this very day.
skins.quote: As you pass through the gloomy corridors of the Hospital of Horror and creep ever closer to its secrets, the roar of a chainsaw behind you reminds you that nobody can escape from its terrors.
